uk.s: Activity 1: Earn 10 USDT when you deposit
Be one of the first 1,000 traders to deposit at least 50 USDT worth of DNA, AXIS, KOR in a single transaction to receive a 10 USDT Bonus.
All rewards will be distributed to eligible accounts within 10 working days after the event concludes.
Trade any of the pairs listed above and reach a minimum spot trading volume of 200 USDT for a chance to win a share of $20,000. The more you trade, the more you win.
Traders must register on the event page to participate in the event.
